authoring_procedure: Read each source text and list the facts, relationships, constraints and distinct-role repetitions a competent reader would need to act on it. Written into this file before any new inventory rule existed, so the oracle could not be shaped by the rules it scores.
independence_note: This is one reviewer, not two. Independence here is procedural (authored from source text with a fixed checklist, before seeing rule output), not inter-rater. A real second reviewer is required before any claim of general precision or recall; see INVENTORY-COVERAGE-01.md §Limits.

classes.structural_constraint: deletion, exception, scope, condition, prohibition, requirement
classes.repeated_role: the same fact appearing more than once with a distinct semantic role

matching_rule.detection: a rule item detects a required item when both are in the same source, their spans overlap, and the item's class equals the required item's class
matching_rule.detection_any_class: same as detection, ignoring the class requirement — reported separately, never merged
matching_rule.precision: a rule item is correct when it overlaps some required item of the same class; every other rule item is a false positive
matching_rule.unit: rule items and required items, not sentences

excluded_from_precision.justification: text addressed to a reader as an instruction is adversarial content, not a source fact; counting it as a false positive would punish a rule for noticing it. Excluded from precision only, never from recall.

unadjudicated.F2a: 62 kB variant; not adjudicated by hand, so excluded from scoring — reported as raw rule counts only
